new_page.title: Richmond Townhomes for Sale | McLennan to Steveston
new_page.description: Search Richmond townhomes for sale. Compare McLennan North, West Cambie, Hamilton and Steveston sold prices, strata fees and complexes with the most sales.

faq.q: How much is a townhome in Richmond?
faq.a: The median Richmond townhome sold for $1,093,000 in McLennan North, $837,900 in Hamilton and $1,150,000 in Steveston South over the year to October 22, 2026. The townhouse benchmark was $1,025,000 in September 2026.

faq.q: Where are most townhomes sold in Richmond?
faq.a: McLennan North, with 87 of 462 sales, then Brighouse South with 42 and West Cambie with 35.

faq.q: Which Richmond townhome area is the cheapest?
faq.a: Hamilton and Granville sit lowest among the larger areas, at $837,900 and $838,000. Brighouse South is $885,250.

faq.q: What are strata fees for a Richmond townhome?
faq.a: Median fees ranged from $366 a month in East Cambie to $536 in Bridgeport, among the 12 busiest neighbourhoods.

faq.q: How fast do Richmond townhomes sell?
faq.a: Hamilton took 12 days at a median and Broadmoor 41. McLennan North took 28.
The Richmond townhouse benchmark moved -2.3% over one year and -10.1% over three.

blocks.text: This search lists townhomes for sale in Richmond: ground-oriented homes in strata complexes, usually with a garage and two or three floors. Houses and condos are separate searches.

462 Richmond townhomes closed in the year to October 22, 2026 across 22 neighbourhoods. McLennan North led with 87 sales, 19% of the total, at a median of $1,093,000. The sold records report Richmond by neighbourhood, so there is no one city median on this page.

blocks.text: Prices cluster in three tiers. Brighouse South ($885,250), Hamilton ($837,900), Saunders ($841,750) and Granville ($838,000) sit below $900,000. East Cambie ($955,000) and Broadmoor ($957,500) sit near $950,000. McLennan North ($1,093,000), West Cambie ($1,050,000), Bridgeport ($1,062,500), Steveston South ($1,150,000), Terra Nova ($1,150,000) and Woodwards ($1,213,900) run above $1,000,000.

Hamilton is the fast one. Its townhomes took a median of 12 days to sell, built around 2008, at $562 a square foot. Broadmoor took 41 days. Median strata fees ranged from $366 a month in East Cambie to $536 in Bridgeport, and McLennan North was $405.

blocks.text: Age shows in the price. Bridgeport’s townhomes, built around 2020, sold at $1,062,500, and Brighouse South’s, built around 1990, at $885,250. The year built and fee columns help you place a complex.
A townhome is usually a strata lot, so read the bylaws and the depreciation report. The BC townhome buying rules page lists what to ask for.

items.t: Ask who pays for roof and exterior repairs, and whether the strata has set money aside.
Check pet, rental and parking bylaws before you offer.
Compare complexes inside the same neighbourhood, using the fee and year built.
For a newer unit, ask what is left of the new-home warranty.
